name: @webtoe/wasm-kernels
description: AssemblyScript sources for WebToe's WASM kernels (video pixel conversion; TEA for the .toe container). Committed artifacts ship with the app; JS fallbacks remain the reference.

scripts.build: asc assembly/index.ts -o build/video-kernels.wasm --runtime stub -O3 && cp build/video-kernels.wasm ../../apps/web/public/wasm/video-kernels.wasm
scripts.build:tea: asc assembly/tea.ts -o build/tea.wasm --runtime stub -O3 && node ../../tools/embed-wasm.mjs build/tea.wasm ../io/src/teaWasm.ts TEA_WASM_BASE64
